Recognizes the causal Landau response in public item3, then implements a flawed item6 scratch probe with the imaginary polynomial at all phase speeds, omitting the compact-support indicator. This incorrectly destroys outside-support calibration agreement. Item7 rejects the causal correction on that faulty numerical comparison and reverts to the real PV law. Final fit/calibration and nonresonant anchors pass, but all three resonant groups fail. This is mixed physics/numerical failure, not a clean intended physical failure.

Implements the causal complex response with the correct compact-support mask and self-consistent dielectric, but differentiates F(u)=15/16*(1-u^2)^2 as 15*u*(u^2-1), four times the correct derivative. Public item4 already contains the factor-four error; item5 identifies the causal physics and final source retains it. Calibration and parameter fit pass because all calibration points have zero resonant contribution, while the three resonant groups fail. At unchanged submitted density, quartering only that imaginary term fixes all groups with exactly zero calibration change. Mathematical normalization error, not a clean retained-PV physical failure.

Final source includes the correctly normalized and support-limited Landau term before taking the real inverse dielectric. Public scratch commands compare causal and PV calibration, implement the causal response, then complete the bounded weighted fit and interface checks. The final model and all seven verifier checks pass. A rejected delete/add patch was followed by a successful update; an unrelated git command fails outside a repository. Both are resolved/noncausal and do not confound this physical pass.
